by_model_fold.statement: Per-model lines are shown on a date only where at least 2 firms hold the model; per-model detail begins 2026-05-15, the first date Global combined 2 firms. Lines held by fewer are folded into one Other Models line, itself shown only where at least 2 firms hold it.

cottonwood.note: structurally absent before first coverage -- NOT an exception (the fold discriminator)

channel_participation.law: A headline value exists on date D IFF every channel IN COVERAGE at D is contributed or carried; any in-coverage channel absent -> headline None. Carried values name their as_of and age; past the declared window a channel is ABSENT FOR REAL (a confidently stale figure loses to an honest gap). Counts are NEVER carried (values carry, rosters never). CONSUMER CONTRACT: a headline value on an exception date is COMPOSED WITH CARRIED INPUTS -- consumers requiring fully-contributed data MUST check meta.channel_participation.exceptions for that date.
channel_participation.pre_schema_note: an artifact vintage MISSING this block entirely has UNKNOWN participation -- the declared default binds only when this meta is present (verification-reader discipline, AE 20260804T222302Z-class)
channel_participation.vocabulary_note: participation says WHETHER a channel entered the point (contributed/carried/absent); cohort_provenance says on WHAT BASIS (measured/interpolated_estimate lattice). The two vocabularies are deliberately separate -- same law as count_basis vs count_provenance -- which is why sanctioned interpolated-backfill dates are NOT exception rows here; basis-sensitive consumers read cohort_provenance/point_class.
channel_participation.windows_note_49financial: null is DELIBERATE, not an omission: 49financial is structurally always contributed at its own frontier because it IS the axis source (fact_model_aum_daily); a window would be dead config inviting false confidence. Revisit if T2.B-era unification moves the frontier source.

honest_none.basis: None because the SOURCE PARTITION IS ABSENT -- no measurement exists for that date. Absent is NOT zero and NOT interpolated. A date whose partition is PRESENT but whose component is None is NOT covered by this marker and must still fail the consistency gate.
honest_none.propagation: global.opal_aggregate_aua is None iff a contributing leg (49F model/non_model or inflection model) is source-absent. global.non_model_aua may still be POPULATED on such a date (it is 49F-only under basis B and 49F had data) -- that is a known component with an unknown total, NOT a defect.
honest_none.verify: lineage-verify: every listed date has NO partition under the named feed prefix, and adjacent non-listed trading days DO (run the positive control -- a sweep that cannot find a known-present partition is a broken sweep).

source_vintage_last.semantics: TO-5 (b) REVAMP-SILVER honest provenance (Andrew/CTO 161549Z): overall = oldest per-firm as_of across the REVAMP's OWN consumed AUA-bearing sources (model_aua = smartx aum_daily [49F] / eclipse fact_portfolios_full [inflection]; partner_custody = schwab fact_rps_s2 [49F] / orion fact_assets [inflection]) -- the artifact's REAL data lineage, NOT the legacy feeders (mirroring them would be false provenance). as_of per source = the last axis date it carries real data. status is TRADING-DAY-AWARE (NEVER#1, CTO 162838Z): trading_days_behind counts NYSE trading days to the settled frontier -- T-1 (tdb<=1) is HEALTHY='current' (an AUM pipeline is T-1 by default; a healthy T-1 read must NOT false-alarm on a Monday), BEHIND only at tdb>=2. UNKNOWN when a load-bearing vintage is unverifiable. Wall-clock age is NOT stored here (CTO 031740Z: clock content lives in _provenance, computed from `overall`, never inside a data-as-of field). Provenance/freshness only (not FE-consumed).
